export const DEFAULT_PLACEHOLDER = 'Type something, or type "/" for commands';

// Loaded by dynamic import from the emoji suggestion plugin, so the editor's first-load chunk stays small.
// Every emoji is one grapheme in its fully-qualified form. Names are Slack and GitHub style aliases.

export type EmojiEntry = {
  emoji: string;
  name: string;
  keywords: readonly string[];
};

function entry(emoji: string, name: string, ...keywords: string[]): EmojiEntry {
  return { emoji, name, keywords };
}

    columnNormalizePlugin,
    // Registered after the column and child-type normalizers, so it runs first and a definition
    // moved into a container becomes a paragraph before those see it.

    voidPropsPlugin,
    toggleRevealPlugin,
    blockSelectionWatchPlugin,
    editorInputRulesPlugin,
    bookmarkToolbarPlatePlugin,
    mediaUiPlatePlugin,
    // Last, and it has no handlers, so it cannot change the order of any handler above.
    editorConfigPlugin,
  ];
}

light.--editor-font-serif: ui-serif, Georgia, Cambria, "Times New Roman", serif
